name: Yr.no (unofficial)
author: Knut Åbjørsbråten
description: Unofficial yr.no (MET Norway) weather: forecast, warnings, hourly graph and tekstvarsel in the bar

barWidget.description: Current conditions, warnings, hourly graph, 4-day forecast and Norwegian text forecast from yr.no's data source (MET Norway)

schema.label: Refresh (minutes)
schema.description: MET Norway asks clients to poll at most every 10 minutes

schema.label: Units
schema.description: metric (°C, m/s, mm), imperial (°F, mph, in) or kelvin

schema.label: Graph hours
schema.description: Hours shown in the hour-by-hour graph

schema.label: Tekstvarsel
schema.description: Show MET's written forecast for the Norwegian land region (hidden elsewhere)

schema.label: Tekstvarsel region
schema.description: Force a region, e.g. Fjellet i Sør-Norge (empty = by location)
